simple.meaning: אַשְׁדּוֹדִי (ʼAshdôwdîy) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “an Ashdodite (often collectively) or inhabitant of Asdod.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 6 times across Joshua, 1 Samuel, Nehemiah, beginning at Joshua 13:3. Its contexts include Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אַשְׁדּוֹדִי (H796).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.short: an Ashdodite (often collectively) or inhabitant of Asdod
definitions.full: H796. Ashdodi אַשְׁדּוֺדִי adjective, of a people Ashdodite , ׳הָא singular collective noun Josh 13:3 ; usually plural (הָ)אַשְׁדּוֺדִים 1Sam 5:3 , 6 ; Neh 4:1 , and as feminine adjective אשׁדודיות נָשִׁים 13:23 Kt (Qr אַשְׁדֳּדִיּוֺת ).
